name: marshmallow-sdrift-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is marshmallow, a Python library for converting complex objects to and from
native Python datatypes: schemas that declare fields, validate input data, deserialize it into application
objects (load) and serialize objects into primitive types (dump), with validators, processing hooks and
nested schemas.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the whole marshmallow package src/marshmallow/ together with README.rst, the documentation pages under docs/ (docs/examples/, docs/extending/ and every top-level docs/*.rst page except: docs/authors.rst, docs/changelog.rst, docs/license.rst and docs/upgrading.rst), the example files under examples/ that those pages include, and the module, class and function docstrings of the package.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.

The environment runs Python 3.12 with no network access. marshmallow is imported from `/workdir/src` (it is
on `PYTHONPATH`; it is not installed as a package); pytest, simplejson and packaging are installed. T
